title: Towards Robust Monocular Depth Estimation: Mixing Datasets for Zero-shot Cross-dataset Transfer
note: Robust relative depth through mixed-dataset training.

title: Vision Transformers for Dense Prediction
note: Introduces dense prediction transformers for depth and segmentation.

title: Depth Anything: Unleashing the Power of Large-Scale Unlabeled Data
note: Large-scale labeled and unlabeled training for robust monocular depth.

title: Depth Anything V2
note: Improves fine details, robustness, and efficiency over V1.

title: Depth Pro: Sharp Monocular Metric Depth in Less Than a Second
note: Sharp metric depth and focal length estimation without camera intrinsics.

title: Metric3D: Towards Zero-shot Metric 3D Prediction from A Single Image
note: Addresses metric ambiguity across camera models.

title: UniDepth: Universal Monocular Metric Depth Estimation
note: Predicts metric 3D points and camera representation from a single image.

title: Marigold: Repurposing Diffusion-Based Image Generators for Monocular Depth Estimation
note: Repurposes latent diffusion priors for zero-shot depth.

title: GeoWizard: Unleashing the Diffusion Priors for 3D Geometry Estimation from a Single Image
note: Uses diffusion priors for single-image depth and normal estimation.

title: Prompting Depth Anything for 4K Resolution Accurate Metric Depth Estimation
note: Uses sparse LiDAR prompts for high-resolution metric depth.

title: Video Depth Anything: Consistent Depth Estimation for Super-Long Videos
note: Extends Depth Anything to temporally consistent long-video depth.

title: VGGT: Visual Geometry Grounded Transformer
note: Predicts cameras, depth maps, point maps, and 3D tracks from one or more views.
